about: A flexible savings account offering higher interest rates for clients who also hold an active Standard Bank transactional account. Can be used as a short-, medium- or long-term savings account.

key_features.description: Funds can be deposited and accessed at any time, without any penalties.
No monthly administration fee is charged.
Up to 6.55% interest rate applies for customers holding an active transactional account.
Grow savings by redeeming UCount Rewards points into the SaveUp account.
Withdraw funds at any time without paying any penalties.

interest_rates.rate_note: Rate applied for customers holding an active transactional account is the higher preferential rate shown below.
interest_rates.interest_calculation: Interest is calculated daily and paid out monthly.
interest_rates.source_section: page 1-2, Interest rates depending on balance

how_it_works: Start your savings journey with no minimum opening balance.
Earn competitive interest rates from any amount.
Get preferential interest rates when you have a qualifying Standard Bank transactional account.
Funds can be deposited and accessed at any time, without any penalties.
Interest is calculated daily and paid out monthly.
This account is low-risk and guaranteed to grow your savings.

requirements_to_apply_at_branch: ID copy (or passport if not an SA citizen).
Proof of residence not older than 3 months.
eligibility.minors: If a minor, consent of a parent or guardian is required.
eligibility.source_section: page 2, What you'll need to apply at a branch

faqs.question: What is the difference between SaveUp and PureSave?
faqs.answer: With SaveUp, you earn a higher interest rate if you also have a transactional account with Standard Bank. With PureSave, you earn interest regardless of whether you bank with Standard Bank or not.

faqs.question: From what balance do you start earning interest?
faqs.answer: You start earning interest from as little as R0.01 if you hold an active transactional account.

faqs.question: Who is this account for?
faqs.answer: Anyone looking to grow their money and have anytime access to their funds; those holding a Standard Bank transactional account also benefit from highly competitive interest rates.
